# Weyser Surf Coach

> Weyser is an independent surf coach in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica (Nicoya Peninsula, Puntarenas). He coaches every level, from a first wave in the whitewater to turns on bigger days, and never takes more than three people in the water at once. Bookings are made on WhatsApp.

## Key facts
- Name: Weyser Surf Coach (Google Business Profile: "Weyser surf")
- What: surf coaching and surf lessons for all levels: first timers, families and kids (from age 7), and improvers. An independent coach, not a surf school.
- Where: Santa Teresa, Costa Rica. Usual beaches: Playa Carmen, Mar Azul and Playa Hermosa (a short ride from town). Cedros and Cabuya on request.
- Group size: never more than three people per session.
- Languages: English and Spanish.
- Experience: surfing for 18 years, coaching for 7 years, more than 800 lessons taught. ISA-certified surf coach, lifeguard and CPR certified. 5.0 stars on Google.
- Story: caught his first wave in Malpaís at 11 and taught himself. He learned from other classes, kept what worked and made it better, and started coaching at 22 because he loves the sport and loves teaching it.
- What he tells every student before paddling out: "You're going to have a great time, and you're going to laugh."
- Session length: a short beach briefing (about 15 minutes), then about 90 minutes in the water.
- Book: WhatsApp +506 6008 4391 (https://wa.me/50660084391)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/weyser.surf/
- Website: https://weysersurf.com (English) and https://weysersurf.com/es/ (Spanish)

## Prices (USD)
- Private session: $75 per session
- Group or family session: $65 per person, per session (2 or 3 people)
- Mini Surf Camp, three private sessions planned as one arc: $200 ($25 less than three single sessions)
- Group Mini Surf Camp, the same three sessions for 2 or more people: $170 per person
- Included: surfboard, rashguard, wax, fresh coconut
- Extras: town pickup $5, video analysis $30, photos of your session and lunch for an extra fee
- Payment: PayPal or cash, on the day
- Cancellation: free up to 3 hours before the session

## How he coaches
1. Get up and go: pop up, balance, first real rides.
2. Own the lineup: paddle out, read the sets, know the rules, take green waves without dropping in on anyone.
3. Level up: turns, speed, bigger days.
Every stage includes currents, surf etiquette and where not to be in the water.
